businessGoal: Allow visitors to reach out for support or inquiries through a contact form.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is accessible when navigating to the contact page.
Ensure all required fields are displayed on the contact form.
Confirm that the subject dropdown includes the specified options.
Check that a validation error is shown when the message is fewer than 50 characters.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed and the form is hidden upon successful submission with valid data.
